title: Diverse Molecular Structures across the Whole Star-forming Disk of M83: High-fidelity Imaging at 40 pc Resolution
question: How are molecular gas and molecular clouds distributed across the full star-forming disk of M83, and how do they evolve dynamically and relate to star formation?

recipe.goal: Calibrate 12m, 7m, and TP data and generate the combined TP data cube
recipe.method: Run observatory CASA pipeline on 12m and 7m EBs; calibrate TP spectra in CASA, grid onto 5.62'' pixels with a 6-pixel prolate spheroidal function, solve for relative flux scales across 120 EBs via design matrix inversion, subtract linear baselines from cubes, combine RA and DEC scans with the Emerson & Graeve (1988) method, and convert to Jy/beam.
key_parameters: TP pixel size = 5.62'', prolate spheroidal function size = 6 pixels, effective FWHM = 56.6''

recipe.goal: Convert TP cube to visibilities and jointly deconvolve 12m+7m+TP data cubes
recipe.method: Deconvolve the TP cube with a Gaussian+prolate spheroidal beam and convert to visibilities using TP2VIS, scale 7m and TP visibility weights by 5 and 20, jointly image the 435-pointing mosaic in MIRIAD (INVERT and MOSSDI2) using two-step Steer CLEAN, apply Jorsater & van Moorsel (1995) residual scaling, and convert to Rayleigh-Jeans brightness temperature.
key_parameters: 7m weight scale = 5, TP weight scale = 20, Briggs robust = -0.2, cell size = 0.25''
Channel widths = 5, 2, and 1 km/s; conversion T_b [K] = 25.4 S_nu [Jy]

recipe.goal: Generate 3D signal masks and 2D moment maps
recipe.method: Create two 3D mask cubes (at native resolution and smoothed to 5'') from regions >2 sigma containing at least one >4 sigma peak, expand spatially by one PSF major-axis diameter, combine masks, and compute integrated intensity (mom0), peak temperature (unmasked), velocity field (mom1), and velocity dispersion (mom2, using the 1 km/s cube).
key_parameters: Mask thresholds: >2 sigma envelope with >=1 peak >4 sigma, expanded by 1 PSF major-axis diameter; smoothed cube resolution = 5''

recipe.goal: Fit global disk kinematic and geometric parameters
recipe.method: Fit a rotating disk model to the data cube in 10'' radial bins using 3D-Barolo in three sequential steps: (1) fit V_sys over r = 20-280'' with center fixed to the K-band symmetry center; (2) fit PA and inclination over r = 100-250''; (3) fit V_rot over r >= 100''.
key_parameters: Radial bin = 10''; radial ranges: r = 20-280'' for V_sys, r = 100-250'' for PA and i, r >= 100'' for V_rot
assumptions: Center fixed to K-band isophote symmetry center (13h37m0.57s, -29d51m56.9s); bar pattern speed Omega_b = 57.4 km/s/kpc from Hirota et al. (2014)

recipe.goal: Derive molecular gas masses, surface densities, radial profiles, and regional PDFs
recipe.method: Convert CO fluxes and integrated intensities to H2 and total molecular gas masses and surface densities, compute azimuthally averaged radial profiles in 10'' bins corrected for inclination and PA, and construct PDFs of sigma_v, T_b, I_CO, and T_peak in four radial zones plus masses of filamentary structures.
key_parameters: Radial zones: central (r < 20''), bar (20-80''), inner disk (80-160''), outer disk (160-300''); radial profile bin = 10'' (218 pc)
assumptions: Constant CO-to-H2 conversion factor X_CO = 2.0e20 cm^-2 (K km s^-1)^-1, helium/heavy element factor = 1.36, distance D = 4.5 Mpc, inclination i = 26 deg, thermalized optically-thick CO(1-0) emission with T_CMB = 2.725 K

recipe.goal: Estimate dynamical and gas assembly timescales for filamentary structures
recipe.method: Calculate disk and bar pattern rotation timescales and compare them to the 1D converging-flow assembly timescale t_form = (l_f / Delta_v) (Sigma_f / Sigma_i - 1) for interarm and spiral-arm filamentary structures.
key_parameters: Filament width l_f = 100 pc, surface density contrast Sigma_f / Sigma_i = 10, interarm convergence velocity Delta_v = 10 km/s, spiral arm Delta_v >= 30 km/s
assumptions: 1D coherent converging flow at constant velocity width Delta_v conserving mass

The maximum $T_{\rm b}$ values in the outer disk region are as low as 6-8 K and occur in the wide spiral arms (Figure 7).

score_reason: The paper gives an unusually thorough and transparent account of the observation design, TP data reduction, TP2VIS modifications, weight scaling (5 and 20), MIRIAD two-step CLEAN parameters, residual scaling, 3D masking, and 3D-Barolo fitting ranges. Only minor details (rejected TP EB IDs, baseline fit windows, and exact polygon boundaries for individual filament masses) are omitted.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA dataset (2017.1.00079.S) with a well-specified joint-deconvolution and analysis recipe and clear quantitative targets (total flux, H2 mass, 3D-Barolo disk kinematic parameters, regional PDF peaks).
